description: This file contains SQL source code defining a table, stored procedures, and query templates related to Orleans persistent storage using MySQL. It includes schema definitions, stored procedures for clearing and writing grain state data, and queries for reading, writing, and clearing storage entries.

methods.name: ClearStorage
methods.description: A stored procedure that sets the payload to NULL and updates the version for a specific grain identified by its hashes and IDs, effectively clearing its stored state.

methods.name: WriteToStorage
methods.description: A stored procedure that inserts or updates the payload and version for a specific grain in OrleansStorage, handling concurrency with version checks.
